name: GGGI Small Grants Program (Ocean Conservancy / Global Ghost Gear Initiative)
amount_note: Inaugural round funded 3-4 projects up to $30,000 USD each; the 2025 cycle drew requests totaling nearly $1,200,000 USD from members in 21 countries.
relevance: Directly relevant to closing the ghost-gear removal gap this session traced in Nigeria (SOFER) and flagged in Hong Kong (OceansAsia, absent from GGGI's Asia project list). Membership is a prerequisite for eligibility, so any newly-mapped ghost-gear operator not yet a GGGI member would need to join first.
